napa.decimation: none (sparse rake; every level fits corners at full resolution)
napa.noisy_frame_box_averaging: only when the base stride is 2-16 px
napa.threading: none inside a frame; one instance per thread

napa-mtp16.decimation: none (sparse rake; every level fits corners at full resolution)
napa-mtp16.noisy_frame_box_averaging: only when the base stride is 2-16 px
napa-mtp16.threading: none inside a frame; one instance per thread

opencv-aruco3-half16.effective_corner_refinement: subpix on the upsampling pyramid levels
opencv-aruco3-half16.effective_min_marker_side: about 32 px (canonical side 16 px at scale 0.5; the contour gate is 4 x canonical side in the scaled image)
opencv-aruco3-half16.tuning: tuned for speed: ArUco3 at half scale, canonical 16 px (effective min side ~32 px)

opencv-aruco3-min32.effective_corner_refinement: subpix on the upsampling pyramid levels
opencv-aruco3-min32.effective_min_marker_side: about 64 px (canonical side 32 px at scale 0.5; the contour gate is 4 x canonical side in the scaled image)
opencv-aruco3-min32.tuning: tuned for speed: ArUco3 at half scale, canonical 32 px (effective min side ~64 px)

scenario_descriptions.busy-background: 1-3 tags on text, shapes, or checkerboards
scenario_descriptions.clutter-only: Shapes, text, checkerboards, or natural texture with no tag
scenario_descriptions.dark-background: 1-3 tags on a dark or mid-grey background, 36-140 px
scenario_descriptions.decoys: Black-bordered squares with random payloads; none is a valid code
scenario_descriptions.empty: Uniform frame at a random brightness, light noise
scenario_descriptions.frame-edge: 1-3 tags whose quiet zone touches the frame edge
scenario_descriptions.large-tags: One tag filling 45-80% of the frame height
scenario_descriptions.low-contrast: Black and white only 40-90 grey levels apart
scenario_descriptions.many-tags: 2-12 tags of mixed sizes on mixed backgrounds
scenario_descriptions.motion-blur: Linear motion blur, 3-11 px (odd lengths) in any direction
scenario_descriptions.noise: Gaussian sensor noise, sigma 4-14 grey levels
scenario_descriptions.noise-free: 1-3 tags on a plain background with no sensor noise at all
scenario_descriptions.one-tag: One tag, any angle, mild tilt, uniform background
scenario_descriptions.small-tags: 1-4 tags with a 32-53 px black square
scenario_descriptions.steep-angle: 1-3 tags tilted 40-65 degrees away from the camera
scenario_descriptions.stress-clutter-noisy: No tags: shapes, text, checkerboards, or texture with sigma 6-12 noise.
scenario_descriptions.stress-dense: Up to 30-80 non-overlapping tags of 36-80 px (scaled), on mixed backgrounds.
scenario_descriptions.stress-heavy-noise: Sensor noise sigma 15-30 grey levels, beyond the corpus's 4-14.
scenario_descriptions.stress-tiny: 1-4 tags with a 12-31 px black square: below NAPA's default min_tag_px of 32.
scenario_descriptions.underexposed: Dark frame: everything scaled to 15-35% brightness, then noise
scenario_descriptions.uneven-light: Lighting gradient (30-60% at the dark end) plus vignetting
